claims: FHA loans are insured by the Federal Housing Administration.
FHA loans are government-backed mortgages.
FHA loans require a minimum down payment of 3.5% for credit scores of 580 or higher.
FHA loans require a 10% down payment for credit scores between 500 and 579.
The minimum credit score for FHA loans is 500.
Credit scores of 580 or higher offer better terms for FHA loans.
FHA mortgage insurance requires an upfront fee of 1.75%.
FHA mortgage insurance requires annual premiums paid monthly.
FHA mortgage insurance premiums are required for the life of the loan in most cases.
FHA loan limits vary by county.
HUD updates FHA loan limits annually.
Properties financed with FHA loans must be the borrower's primary residence.
Properties financed with FHA loans must pass an FHA appraisal to ensure safety and security.
FHA loans are generally assumable.
Assumable FHA loans allow a buyer to take over the seller's current mortgage rate.
FHA loans are used for purchasing 1-4 unit primary residences.
FHA loans are used for manufactured housing and mobile homes.
FHA 203(k) loans are for home renovations.
FHA streamlined refinancing usually requires no appraisal.
FHA streamlined refinancing usually requires no income check.
FHA loans allow gift funds.
